Enhance FileBaseController functionality and clarity

Updated the FileBaseController class with detailed XML documentation for methods and properties. Refined file management methods to include null checks and improved logging. Modified LoadFilesAsync to accept a single file extension and enhanced error handling. Adjusted logic for managing the selected index of files for better user experience. Overall, these changes improve code robustness and maintainability.

Fix logging and syntax issues in controllers

Added a warning log in `FileBaseController.cs` for cases where no files are found, and ensured proper closure of code blocks. In `MainViewModel.cs`, corrected syntax by adding a missing semicolon to improve code clarity and correctness.

Enhance file management and settings handling

- Added `FileTidyDatabase` using directive in `FileBaseController.cs`.
- Introduced `_settingsController` to manage settings and updated the constructor.
- Refactored `GetFile` method to use `_selectIndex` and added nullability support.
- Implemented `GetNextFile` and `GetPreviousFile` methods for navigation.
- Added `LoadFilesAsync` method to load files based on settings.
- Defined `ESettings` enum for window settings in `ESettings.cs`.
- Updated `MainViewModel` with `LoadFilesCommand` and refactored loading logic.
- Removed old synchronous `LoadFiles` method in favor of an async version.
- Adjusted window position and size methods to use `ESettings` enum.
- Enhanced UI in `MainView.axaml` with a new button for loading files.

Add design-time support and refactor application structure

- Introduced `DesignTimeFileTidyDbContextFactory` for SQLite setup.
- Updated project dependencies for Entity Framework Core design tools.
- Generated initial migration files for database schema.
- Enhanced `SettingsController` for asynchronous settings management.
- Refactored `Program.cs` to utilize dependency injection and apply migrations.
- Improved `App.axaml.cs` to correctly retrieve `MainViewModel`.
- Updated `MainView` to bind `DataContext` to `MainViewModel`.
- Cleaned up unused code in `MainViewModel.cs` and `MainView.axaml.cs`.
- Implemented window position and size persistence in `MainWindow`.
- Added `BrowserLifeSpanHandler` for managing pop-up windows.
- Updated UI components in `MainView.axaml` to use commands.
- Ensured proper initialization and state management in `MainWindow.axaml.cs`.

Enhance UI and functionality for chaos folder selection

- Updated `FileTidyUI.csproj` to include a new folder for views.
- Added `ReactiveCommand` in `MainViewModel` for selecting a chaos folder, along with properties for file types and folder path management.
- Modified `MainView.axaml` to bind UI elements to new ViewModel properties and replaced click event with command binding.
- Removed legacy code in `MainView.axaml.cs` related to file type management and folder selection.
- Introduced a new layout in `SettingsView.axaml` with a checkbox for analyzing child folders.

Add duplicate management and settings functionality

- Introduced `DupplicateViewModel`, `SettingsViewModel`, and `SortViewModel` classes for managing duplicates, settings, and sorting functionalities.
- Created `DupplicateView` and `SettingsView` user controls for UI management.
- Updated `MainView` to include a `TabControl` for navigation between views, removing outdated UI code.
- Enhanced `SortView` layout and functionality, including a browser control for file content display.
- Added a script to clean up `bin` and `obj` folders from the project directory.

Refactor SortFolderDialog and add SortView user control

- Added parameterless and model-based constructors to `SortFolderDialog`.
- Updated `OKButton_Click` to set action based on edit mode.
- Enhanced `GetValue` method to validate sort path input.
- Reformatted `SortFolderModel` instantiation for consistency.
- Defined a new `UserControl` in `SortView.axaml` with necessary namespaces.
- Created `SortView.axaml.cs` with partial class and initialization logic.

Add database support in SortFolderController

Updated SortFolderController to use FileTidyDatabase for managing sort folders. Introduced a private FileTidyDbContext field and refactored add/remove methods to persist changes in the database.

Modified logging configuration in Program.cs for consistency by removing the Avalonia.Logging directive and using Serilog.Events.LogEventLevel.

Update project to .NET 9.0 and enhance documentation

- Added XML documentation to `BaseController`, `FileBaseController`, `SortFolderController`, and `FileBaseModel` for improved clarity.
- Implemented logging enhancements across controllers and models for better traceability.
- Created `FileTidyDatabase.csproj` and `FileTidyDbContext.cs` to support Entity Framework with DbSet properties for `SortFolderModel` and `BasicSetting`.
- Updated project files to target .NET 9.0 and included necessary references.
- Modified `Program.cs` to incorporate dependency injection for database context and controllers.
- Ensured all projects are correctly referenced in the solution file.

Integrate Serilog and enhance logging infrastructure

- Added Serilog logging to `BaseController` with debug logs.
- Introduced `LoggerExtension` for contextual logging support.
- Removed custom `ILogger` interface in favor of Serilog.
- Updated `Program.cs` with improved logging configuration:
  - File and console logging with enriched contextual data.
  - Minimum log level set to `Warning`.
  - Added unhandled exception logging.
- Modified `GetFilesInDirectory` to support `searchInChildFolder`.
- Updated `FileTidyBase.csproj` and `FileTidyUI.csproj`:
  - Added Serilog package reference (v4.3.0).
  - Upgraded Avalonia packages to v11.3.0.
- Performed general code cleanup for readability and maintainability.

6 update UI

Refactor settings handling and update UI layout

- Changed parameter types in `OptionsController.cs` from `string` to `OPTIONS` enum for improved type safety.
- Updated `HotkeyController.cs` to use the new `OPTIONS` enum in `ReloadKeysFromOptions`.
- Commented out significant portions of code in `TextController.cs`, likely for debugging or refactoring.
- Revamped `SettingsView.axaml` layout to include new fields for "Language," "Count World As Total Deaths," and "Twitch Name," along with a new section for "Timer Hotkeys."

Add timer and recording functionality with controllers

- Introduced `RecordingController` and `StreamingController` as singletons in DI.
- Updated `MarkerController` to utilize `StreamingController`.
- Refactored `RecordingController` to inherit from `TimerController`, simplifying logic.
- Created `TimerController` for managing timer functionality.
- Updated XAML files to add UI elements for timer and recording controls.
- Refactored `TallyViewModel` to manage streaming and recording states with observable properties.
- Changed command bindings in `TallyView.axaml` to use asynchronous commands.

Refactor DI and enhance overlay settings management

Updated `Program.cs` to register `TallyViewModel` and `OverlayViewModel` as singletons. Added `AvaloniaColorJsonConverter` for JSON serialization of `Color`. Introduced `OverlaySettingsModel` for overlay configuration. Modified `JsonSettingsService` to use the new converter. Enhanced `MainViewModel` to include and initialize the new view models. Improved `OverlayViewModel` with debouncing and JSON save/load functionality. Updated XAML files to bind view models correctly and removed direct instantiation in `OverlayView`. Logged warnings related to locale resources and network requests.

Add ColorPicker and WebView functionality

- Integrated a new style reference for the ColorPicker in `App.axaml`.
- Added `WebViewControl-Avalonia` package to `FallenTallyAvalon.csproj`.
- Updated `OverlayViewModel.cs` with properties for font customization, border size, shadow size, and color bindings.
- Replaced TextBox with a ScrollViewer containing a WebView in `OverlayView.axaml`, restructuring the layout for font customization controls.
- Set DataContext to `OverlayViewModel` in `OverlayView.axaml.cs` for proper data binding.
- Updated `ceflog.txt` with logs related to the WebView component.

Add layout for font and style configuration in OverlayView

Implemented a new layout in `OverlayView.axaml` using a
`DockPanel` and `Grid`. The layout includes a `TextBox`,
`GridSplitter`, and a `ScrollViewer` with a nested `Grid`
that contains labels and input fields for font properties,
border size, shadow size, and color settings.

Update UI components and enhance view model logic

- Added DataGrid theme reference in `App.axaml`.
- Adjusted dimensions and added icons in dialog windows.
- Initialized `_markers` collection in `TallyViewModel.cs` and added properties for button state management.
- Updated icon in `MainWindow.axaml`.
- Improved layout and command bindings in `TallyView.axaml`, including making the markers DataGrid read-only.

Add location and death management features

- Registered LocationController and DeathController in Program.cs.
- Updated App.axaml.cs with new using directives.
- Modified AddDeath method in DeathController to use optional parameters.
- Cleaned up DeathLocationModel.cs and reorganized using directives.
- Moved ConfirmationDialog to FallenTallyAvalon.Dialogue namespace.
- Updated ConfirmationDialog.axaml.cs with new namespace and InitializeComponent method.
- Removed unnecessary using directive from GameDialogWindow.axaml.cs.
- Created LocationDialogWindow.axaml and LocationDialogWindow.axaml.cs for managing locations.
- Updated GameDialogWindowViewModel to handle dialog close actions.
- Implemented LocationDialogWindowViewModel for state management and commands.
- Enhanced TallyViewModel with commands for managing locations and deaths.
- Updated TallyView.axaml to bind UI elements to new commands and properties.
merge

Refactor GameController and enhance dialog functionality

- Removed `_activeGame` field and related methods in `GameController`, introducing a more direct approach to manage game statistics.
- Updated `EditName` method to accept two `GameStatsModel` parameters for comprehensive updates.
- Added `GetGame` method to retrieve games by name directly from the database.
- Introduced `ConfirmationDialog` and its view model for structured user confirmations with command bindings.
- Enhanced `GameDialogWindow` with a new constructor for pre-filling existing game data and improved layout using a `Grid`.
- Updated `TallyViewModel` with new commands for editing and removing games, ensuring UI reflects current game data.
- Modified XAML files for `ConfirmationDialog` and `GameDialogWindow` to improve layouts and bindings.
- Improved button layout in `TallyView.axaml` for better alignment and consistency.

Refactor dialog handling to use view models

- Removed registration of `IDialog<GameStatsModel>` in `Program.cs` and registered `GameDialogWindow` with `GameController` as a singleton.
- Updated `GameDialogWindow.axaml` to bind buttons and text boxes to view model commands and properties, enhancing MVVM implementation.
- Refactored `GameDialogWindow.axaml.cs` to remove `IDialog<GameStatsModel>` implementation and initialize a new `GameDialogWindowViewModel`.
- Added asynchronous method `ShowDialogueAsync` to `IDialog.cs` for improved dialog handling.
- Introduced `GameDialogWindowViewModel` to manage game name and prefix logic, along with save and close commands.
- Modified `TallyViewModel.cs` to eliminate dependency on `IDialog<GameStatsModel>` and updated `AddGame` method to use the new dialog approach.
- Enhanced data binding in `TallyView.axaml` for `ComboBox` to improve user interaction.

Refactor codebase for improved organization and DI

This commit introduces a new namespace `FallenTallyAvalon` and adds several classes and interfaces, including `IDialog<T>`, `ServiceLocator`, and `GameDialogWindow`, to enhance dialog management and service location.

The `Program.cs` file has been updated to configure dependency injection more effectively, registering services like `GameController`, `GameDialogWindow`, and `SQLiteDBContext`.

The `DeathController` and `LocationController` classes have been modified to accept models directly, improving data handling clarity.

The `TallyViewModel` now utilizes a dialog interface for adding games, enhancing user interaction.

UI components in `GameDialogWindow.axaml` and `TallyView.axaml` have been updated to bind commands to buttons for better interaction with the view model.

Additionally, the `MainWindow` class has been modified to maintain a static instance for easier access throughout the application.

Overall, these changes promote a more modular and maintainable architecture, leveraging dependency injection and improving separation of concerns.

Add Serilog logging and simplify app initialization

Updated `Program.cs` to implement logging with Serilog and refactor the `Main` and `BuildAvaloniaApp` methods for clarity. Removed the `OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted` method in `App.axaml.cs` to streamline application structure and eliminate unnecessary data validation handling.

Add MarkerView control and update TallyView UI

Introduced a new `MarkerView` user control with a grid layout,
featuring a `DataGrid` and buttons for enhanced functionality.
Added a corresponding code-behind file for `MarkerView`.

Replaced a `ComboBox` with a `TextBox` in `TallyView.axaml`
to improve the UI in the specified grid location.

Updated `FallenTallyAvalon.csproj` to include a reference to
`Avalonia.Controls.DataGrid`, enabling the use of `DataGrid`
controls in the project.

Add MainView with UI and logic for Avalonia app

Added `MainView.axaml` to define the UI for the main window,
featuring a centered `TextBlock` and `Button` within a `Grid`.
Created `MainView.axaml.cs` to implement the code-behind logic,
including a constructor that initializes the XAML. Declared
the `MainView` class in the `FallenTally.View` namespace,
inheriting from `Window`.

Refactor UI, add DI, logging, and upgrade dependencies

Modernized the application by upgrading dependencies, including `Avalonia.Desktop` to `11.3.0` and `CommunityToolkit.Mvvm` to `8.4.0`. Introduced dependency injection using `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection` and structured logging with `Serilog`. Enhanced the UI with a custom `FluentTheme`, reusable icons, and modularized views for improved maintainability.

Refactored `Program.cs` to streamline application startup and added exception handling for unhandled exceptions. Updated `App.axaml.cs` to support future service registration and removed redundant data validation logic. Removed outdated `MainView` components in favor of a dynamic, modular structure. Added `Icons.axaml` for reusable `StreamGeometry` definitions.

These changes improve maintainability, visual consistency, and extensibility while modernizing the codebase.
